verdict.summary: Yes as a shared-services architecture — not as forked Gabba microsites. Current state ≈ L1 (tenant-keyed platform). Target near-term ≈ L2. Public multi-clinic attraction ≈ L3 (requires golden corpus + domains).

alignsWithPlatform.note: Platform can operate draft tenants; attraction content layer still single-clinic.

dataStructures.finding: Most attraction APIs/schemas key clinicId/clinicSlug; proposal content JSON still Gabba-literal; knowledge graph is a single-clinic instance.

clinicSpecificSettings.finding: ClinicProfile/branding exists on platform; attraction packs, personas, pathway, governance UI hardcode WMC strings.

capacityPlanning.finding: Room capacity, session matching, workforce planning are clinic-scoped designs but not one shared CapacityService product.

onboardingWorkflows.finding: Cases/stages keyed by clinicId; notification and workflow copy need merge fields and membership-scoped gates.

contentGovernance.finding: Hard rules (agency/salary/PN/hype) are network-global and portable; approver pools and MedicalClinic @id must be dual-scoped.

capabilityLevels.name: Single-clinic prototype
capabilityLevels.meaning: Current attraction proposals with Gabba-hardcoded content

capabilityLevels.name: Tenant-keyed platform
capabilityLevels.meaning: Clinic row, profile, admin switcher, scoped ops; attraction not fully productised

capabilityLevels.name: Shared attraction services
capabilityLevels.meaning: Shared engines + ClinicAttractionConfig + per-clinic content documents

capabilityLevels.name: Multi-live attraction
capabilityLevels.meaning: Each live clinic publishes governed attraction surfaces on its host

capabilityLevels.name: Network intelligence
capabilityLevels.meaning: Cross-clinic pattern roll-up with strict isolation on PII and vacancies

sharedServices.responsibility: Resolve slug → clinicId, profile, branding, flags
Rooms, sessions, nursing cover, unmet demand

nonGoals: Fork entire attraction suite per clinic
Cross-clinic EOI or vacancy visibility by default
Reuse Gabba schema @id / HotDoc IDs on another clinic
Weaken network hard rules for any tenant
